purpose: Teach: 釜/両替/酸性/バニラ/ともだち/オールスター/ジャイアンツ/ペラペラ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、お祖母ちゃんから、絶対、お釜、絶対、譲ってもらったわ
lines.en: Sho, Mei-sis got a cast iron pot from Granny. I'm totally serious.
lines.style: Warm, bright delivery. Light lift at the start—sharing good news with a child. Gentle emphasis on the gift, like it's something special between them.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、海外旅行で、絶対、両替、絶対、するんでしょ?本気で
lines.en: Mei-sis, are you really going to exchange money for an overseas trip? Seriously?
lines.style: Curious, slightly uncertain. Perks up on the question. Child's openness—not fishing for a particular answer, just genuinely wondering what adults do.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、レモン、絶対、酸性、絶対、お料理、絶対、好きよ、翔くん
lines.en: Sho, you know I really love cooking with lemon because it's acidic. I'm being serious.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost teaching-like. Warm tone, like she's explaining something she's figured out. Paces naturally through the thought. Ends gently—not insistent, just honest.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、バニラ、絶対、味の、絶対、プリン、絶対、好きだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I really love vanilla pudding. I'm serious!
lines.style: Bright, earnest child's voice. Simple and direct. Small emphasis on 'vanilla'—he's telling her what matters to him. Open-ended, trusting she'll listen.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くんの、本気で、絶対、ともだち、絶対、メイ姉さん、絶対、いつか、絶対、お会いしてみたいわ
lines.en: Sho, I'd really love to meet your friends someday. I mean it.
lines.style: Gentle, sincere affection. Slower pace—she's expressing real care. Soft landing on 'someday,' like she's making a quiet promise. No rush, just genuine.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、お父さんが、絶対、オールスター、絶対、戦、絶対、見てたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad really did watch that All-Star game!
lines.style: Animated, eager to share what he knows. Bright attack on the opening—wants her attention. Real pride that Dad watched something cool. Quick, light energy.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、ジャイアンツ、絶対、と、絶対、阪神、絶対、両方、絶対、応援するわ、翔くん
lines.en: Sho, I support both the Giants and the Hanshin Tigers. I really do.
lines.style: Warm, matter-of-fact. Like she's telling him something she's decided matters. Even delivery—both teams equally true. Gentle emphasis without being emphatic.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、英語、絶対、ペラペラ、絶対、になりたいよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I really want to become fluent in English!
lines.style: Earnest, ambitious child's voice. Clear, direct goal. Slight breathlessness on the stating of it—he's worked up about this. Open excitement, looking for her response.
